title: Venezuelan Chicken and Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Venezuela, combining chicken, rice, and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the pilaf seasoning, tomato paste, and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cover the skillet and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
